about.title: A little about me
about.p1: I’m Ara Ghahramanyan, a computer science student at Collège de Bois-de-Boulogne in Montréal. I’m drawn to the parts of software you don’t always see: the data model, the API contract, the decision that keeps a system understandable.
about.p2: My projects are how I learn. I build something, find the rough edges, and work out how to make it better. I’m looking for an internship where I can bring that curiosity to a team.
about.p3: Outside programming, I train in wrestling, judo and weightlifting, follow financial markets, and spend my summers organizing activities for seniors at a community centre in Montréal.
